LanguageData.LP_TrollHide.label: troll hide
LanguageData.LP_TrollHide.description: Tanned troll hide, thick and elastic, still keeping a little regenerative power after leaving its owner: clothing made from it restores 1% durability per day. Only obtained by butchering trolls.
LanguageData.LP_Mithral.label: mithril
LanguageData.LP_Mithral.description: A silvery legendary metal, light as a feather yet nearly as tough as steel. Mithril items weigh only half as much, and mithril clothing doesn't slow the wearer.\n\nFrom rare mithril veins deep in the mountains (dwarves get double yield), occasionally sold in small amounts by league caravans.
LanguageData.LP_Adamantine.label: adamantine
LanguageData.LP_Adamantine.description: A dark purple legendary metal, almost indestructible. Adamantine melee weapons deal double damage to buildings and mechanoids; adamantine armor halves the armor penetration of incoming attacks.\n\nFrom adamantine veins rarer than mithril; only a few caravans sell it.
LanguageData.LP_ColdIron.label: cold iron
LanguageData.LP_ColdIron.description: Steel tempered with silver, always cold to the touch. Cold iron melee weapons deal +25% damage against people with a psylink and elves (with Mythic Bloodlines active, baize bloodlines count too). Tempered at the alchemy table from 3 steel and 1 silver.
LanguageData.LP_MineableMithral.label: mithril vein
LanguageData.LP_MineableMithral.description: Rock threaded with fine mithril veins. Dwarves get double yield when mining it.
LanguageData.LP_MineableAdamantine.label: adamantine vein
LanguageData.LP_MineableAdamantine.description: Rock embedded with dark purple adamantine, so hard it can barely be mined.
